_comment: Size ceilings for files that are loaded into the model's context eagerly — before the
session does anything, and re-sent on every turn. Checked by
scripts/check_context_budget.py from the pre-push hook and from CI.
Only budget files that are actually loaded that way. CLAUDE.md is. DEPLOY.md is not:
it is read on demand, when someone is about to release, not on every turn.
CLAUDE.md measured 11,974 bytes when this file was written (A17). The cap sits far
enough above that for the WARN band (90% of the cap, 12,600 bytes) to be a useful
nudge rather than something that fires on arrival.
The number is a ratchet. Lower it when the file shrinks; raising it needs a commit

budgets.note: Rules and reference that must hold in every session. Anything that is a record rather than a rule belongs in docs/ and is read on demand.
